{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data with explicit dtype specification to avoid parsing issues
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv', dtype={'biomarker_baseline': 'float64'})

# Check the data types again
df_dtypes = df.dtypes
print("Data types after explicit loading:\n", df_dtypes)

# Check the first few values of biomarker_baseline
df_biomarker_head = df['biomarker_baseline'].head()
print("First few biomarker_baseline values:\n", df_biomarker_head)

# Check for any non-numeric values or missing data
print("\nMissing values in biomarker_baseline:", df['biomarker_baseline'].isnull().sum())
print("Non-numeric values (if any):", df['biomarker_baseline'].apply(lambda x: isinstance(x, str)).sum())"}
